title: The Lord Is My Strength and My Shield

questions.question: To you, O Lord, I call; my rock, be not deaf to me, lest, if you be silent to me, I become like those who do what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 28:1 (ESV): "...I become like those who go down to the pit."

questions.question: Hear the voice of my pleas for mercy, when I cry to you for what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 28:2 (ESV): "Hear the voice of my pleas for mercy, when I cry to you for help,"

questions.question: When I lift up my hands toward your most holy what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 28:2 (ESV): "...when I lift up my hands toward your most holy sanctuary."

questions.question: Do not drag me off with the wicked, with the workers of evil, who speak peace with their neighbors while what is in their hearts?
questions.explanation: Psalm 28:3 (ESV): "...who speak peace with their neighbors while mischief is in their hearts."

questions.question: Blessed be the Lord! For he has heard the voice of my what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 28:6 (ESV): "Blessed be the Lord! For he has heard the voice of my pleas for mercy."

questions.question: Give to them according to their work and according to the evil of their what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 28:4 (ESV): "Give to them according to their work and according to the evil of their deeds;"

questions.question: Because they do not regard the works of the Lord or the work of his hands, he will tear them down and build them up when?
questions.explanation: Psalm 28:5 (ESV): "...he will tear them down and build them up no more."

questions.question: The Lord is my strength and my what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 28:7 (ESV): "The Lord is my strength and my shield;"

questions.question: In him my heart trusts, and I am helped; my heart exults, and with my what I give thanks to him?
questions.explanation: Psalm 28:7 (ESV): "...and with my song I give thanks to him."

questions.question: The Lord is the strength of his people; he is the saving refuge of his what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 28:8 (ESV): "The Lord is the strength of his people; he is the saving refuge of his anointed."

questions.question: Oh, save your people and bless your what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 28:9 (ESV): "Oh, save your people and bless your heritage!"

questions.question: Be their shepherd and carry them when?
questions.explanation: Psalm 28:9 (ESV): "Be their shepherd and carry them forever."

questions.question: Give to them according to the work of their what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 28:4 (ESV): "...give to them according to the work of their hands;"

questions.question: How many times does "my strength" appear in this Psalm?
questions.explanation: Psalm 28:7 ("The Lord is my strength") and 28:8 ("The Lord is the strength") - strictly speaking "my strength" once, but context shows God as strength twice.

key_verse_text: The Lord is my strength and my shield; in him my heart trusts, and I am helped.
